biotools.summary: Curare and GenExVis provide a toolkit for analyzing and visualizing RNA-Seq data, streamlining workflows and facilitating differential gene expression experiments with a focus on reproducibility and user-friendliness.  Curare builds RNA-Seq analysis workflows and GenExVis visualizes results.
